title: B4d: bench fetch identifies itself (no impersonation, no stealth headers) and records the real HTTP status, failing closed
spec:
Why: security review T-0033 on bench.py (full text: /Users/k3ntaw/code/orchestrator/.orchestrator/tasks/T-0033.json). HIGH: Fetcher.get() is called with Scrapling defaults, which mean impersonate="chrome" (curl_cffi TLS/JA3 fingerprint spoofing) plus stealthy_headers=True (synthetic browser headers, fake Google referer). That is bot-detection evasion and contradicts the banner comment and the decision recorded 2026-09-17: the fetch must be identified and plain. MED: fetch() writes http_status: 200 as a literal; a 403/429/503 or challenge page would be stored as a successful fetch with empty models.

What (2 files: orchestrator/bench.py, tests/test_orchestrator.py; worktree off goal/T-0005 which has the matcher fix e29a97e):
1. fetch_html: call Fetcher.get with impersonate=None (or the parameter that disables it in the installed version — check inspect.signature and the source of scrapling.engines.static) and stealthy_headers=False, and pass headers={"User-Agent": "orchestrator-bench/1 (+https://github.com/K3NTAW/orchestrator)", "Accept": "text/html"}. No referer. Return (status_code, html): read the real status from the response object (page.status or equivalent; confirm the attribute name from the installed package). Keep timeout.
2. fetch(): if status != 200 or the body is shorter than 10 KB or parse_chunks finds zero records, do NOT overwrite bench.json; return {"error": f"fetch failed: status {status}, {len(html)} bytes, {n} records"} and leave the previous file intact; record the real status in the file on success. Add "request": {"user_agent": ..., "impersonate": false, "stealth_headers": false} to the written provenance so the file itself shows how it was fetched.
3. tests: fetch_html is monkeypatched in the existing tests; add: a fetch() with fetch_html returning (403, "<html>blocked</html>") leaves an existing bench.json byte-identical and returns an error dict; a successful fetch writes request.impersonate == false and http_status from the tuple. Add a test that inspects the fetch_html source (inspect.getsource) and asserts it contains "stealthy_headers=False" and an "orchestrator-bench" User-Agent.
4. Then run one live `uv run orchestrator bench fetch --force` with the identified client and report the real status and matched count (if the site refuses the identified client, report that and do not add impersonation back; the Planner decides).

Run `uv run python -m unittest tests/test_orchestrator.py`. Commit: "bench: identified plain fetch (no impersonation or stealth headers); real HTTP status; fail closed" with a revert-path body.
acceptance: uv run python -m unittest tests/test_orchestrator.py exits 0 with the new fail-closed and identification tests
fetch_html passes stealthy_headers=False and no impersonation, with an orchestrator-bench User-Agent (source-inspected test)
a non-200 or empty fetch never overwrites bench.json
bench.json written by a successful fetch contains http_status from the response and request.impersonate == false
git diff --stat limited to orchestrator/bench.py and tests/test_orchestrator.py

result.summary:
Committed on `task/T-0038`.

## Summary

**Files changed:** `orchestrator/bench.py`, `tests/test_orchestrator.py`

- `fetch_html`: now explicitly passes `impersonate=None` and `stealthy_headers=False` to `Fetcher.get` (verified against the installed scrapling's `GetRequestParams`/`_merge_request_args` that these disable TLS/JA3 impersonation and the fake-Google-referer/browser-header stealth path), sends only `{"User-Agent": "orchestrator-bench/1 (...)", "Accept": "text/html"}`, and returns `(page.status, html)` instead of just html.
- `fetch()`: fails closed — if status != 200, body < 10KB, or zero parsed records, it returns `{"error": ...}` and leaves `bench.json` untouched. On success it writes the real `http_status` and a `request: {user_agent, impersonate: false, stealth_headers: false}` block.
- Tests: updated the existing fetch test for the new `(status, html)` contract, added a fail-closed test (403 leaves the file byte-identical), a success test asserting `http_status`/`request.impersonate`, and a source-inspection test confirming `fetch_html`'s literal `stealthy_headers=False` and `orchestrator-bench` User-Agent.

**Test output:** `uv run python -m unittest tests/test_orchestrator.py` → 65 tests, OK. `.claude/hooks/tests-green.sh` gate → exit 0, no failures.

**Live check:** `uv run orchestrator bench fetch --force` against the identified plain client got HTTP 200 (`referer: None`, confirming no stealth headers), matched 6/8 models — the site doesn't require impersonation, so none was added back.

Committed as `913a5a9` on `task/T-0038`.
